visibleTestCases.title: Start Checkout Supervisor Pipeline
visibleTestCases.explanation: Starts checkout_sup and confirms all three pipeline workers are alive.
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin case whereis(checkout_sup) of undefined -> ok; OldSup1 -> unlink(OldSup1), exit(OldSup1, shutdown), timer:sleep(20) end, {ok, Sup} = checkout_sup:start_link(), {ok, #{db_pid := Db, cache_pid := Cache, gateway_pid := Gw}} = checkout_sup:get_pipeline_pids(), unlink(Sup), catch supervisor:stop(Sup), is_pid(Db) andalso is_pid(Cache) andalso is_pid(Gw) end

visibleTestCases.title: Chaos Test: Gateway Crash (Isolated)
visibleTestCases.explanation: Kills order_gateway; confirms DB and Cache PIDs are preserved while Gateway restarts with new PID.
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin case whereis(checkout_sup) of undefined -> ok; OldSup2 -> unlink(OldSup2), exit(OldSup2, shutdown), timer:sleep(20) end, {ok, Sup} = checkout_sup:start_link(), {ok, #{db_pid := Db1, cache_pid := Cache1, gateway_pid := Gw1}} = checkout_sup:get_pipeline_pids(), exit(Gw1, kill), timer:sleep(50), {ok, #{db_pid := Db2, cache_pid := Cache2, gateway_pid := Gw2}} = checkout_sup:get_pipeline_pids(), unlink(Sup), catch supervisor:stop(Sup), {Db1 =:= Db2, Cache1 =:= Cache2, Gw1 =/= Gw2} end

visibleTestCases.title: Chaos Test: Cache Crash (Cascades to Gateway)
visibleTestCases.explanation: Kills pricing_cache; confirms Cache and Gateway restart with new PIDs while DB Pool PID is untouched.
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin case whereis(checkout_sup) of undefined -> ok; OldSup3 -> unlink(OldSup3), exit(OldSup3, shutdown), timer:sleep(20) end, {ok, Sup} = checkout_sup:start_link(), {ok, #{db_pid := Db1, cache_pid := Cache1, gateway_pid := Gw1}} = checkout_sup:get_pipeline_pids(), exit(Cache1, kill), timer:sleep(50), {ok, #{db_pid := Db2, cache_pid := Cache2, gateway_pid := Gw2}} = checkout_sup:get_pipeline_pids(), unlink(Sup), catch supervisor:stop(Sup), {Db1 =:= Db2, Cache1 =/= Cache2, Gw1 =/= Gw2} end
